groups.title: The run and its clock
groups.title_it: La run e il suo orologio

agent_custom_features.note: Free key-value features attached to an agent.

agent_opinion.note: Opinion of an agent on a topic in a round, with the interlocutor and the post that caused the change.

columns.name: id_interacted_with
columns.desc: Account whose content changed the opinion.

columns.name: stubborn
columns.desc: 1 if the agent does not change its mind.

articles.note: News articles fetched from the websites.

emotions.note: Catalogue of the emotion labels (28 of the GoEmotions taxonomy in the forum).

follow.note: Every follow and unfollow as an event: one row per pair and action, with the round of the change.

columns.name: action
columns.desc: follow or unfollow (the last action of the pair).

images.note: Images (with their description from the vision model) attached to posts.

memory_community_digests.note: Periodic digest of the community: top topics, norms, memes, polarising issues (only with memory on).

memory_interaction_events.note: Events recorded for the agent memory: what the agent did or saw, with importance and tone (only with memory on).

memory_items.note: Searchable memory items (events, reflections, cards) with their embeddings (only with memory on).

columns.name: updated_at
columns.desc: When the row was last updated.

memory_social_cards.note: Running summary of the relation between two agents: affinity, conflict, humour and trust (only with memory on).

memory_thread_cards.note: Running summary of a thread for an agent: gist, its role, main participants (only with memory on).

columns.name: my_role
columns.desc: Role of the agent in the thread.

mentions.note: Accounts mentioned in a post, with the round and whether the mention was answered.

post.note: Every post and every comment (a comment has `comment_to`): text, author, thread, round, the news or image it shares, reaction counter and moderation flags.

columns.name: tweet
columns.desc: Text of the post or comment.

columns.name: comment_to
columns.desc: Post a comment answers; -1 for a post.

columns.name: is_moderation_comment
columns.desc: 1 if the comment is a moderation notice.

post_emotions.note: Emotions attached to a post by the annotation.

post_hashtags.note: Links a post to its hashtags.

post_sentiment.note: Sentiment (VADER: negative, neutral, positive, compound) of posts, comments and reactions.

post_toxicity.note: Toxicity scores of a post (Perspective API or the local model).

reactions.note: The reaction of an account to a post (like, love, laugh, angry, sad), one row each.

columns.name: type
columns.desc: Kind of reaction (like, love, laugh, angry, sad).

recommendations.note: The list of posts the recommender offered to an account in a round.

reported.note: Reports filed by an account against another account or a post.

rounds.note: The time axis: one row per round (a simulated hour), with day and hour; every `round` column points here.

stress_reward.note: Variations of stress and reward of each account, with the event that caused them and the round.
rules: check ck_stress_reward_value: (type = 'aggregate' AND value >= 0 AND value <= 1) OR (type = 'variation' AND value >= -1 AND value <= 1)

sys_messages.note: System messages to an account (for example a moderation notice), with their duration.

user_interest.note: Interests of an account, with the round in which they were recorded.

user_mgmt.note: One row per account (agent, page or human): persona, Big Five traits, archetype, recommenders, activity settings, joined and left rounds.

columns.name: user_type
columns.desc: Kind of model that drives the agent.

columns.name: left_on
columns.desc: Round of departure; empty while active.

voting.note: Votes of an account on a content item.

websites.note: News sources (RSS feeds) the platform reads from.
